model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of iterations and loss for several different models. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick marks every 20000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. A purple line, labeled “Vanilla”, begins at approximately 3.3 and declines to approximately 2.5 across the x-axis, with a steep decline in the first 20000 iterations, then gradually leveling off. An orange line, labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 3.2 and declines to approximately 2.47, showing an initial steep decline and then a more gradual leveling off. A green line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)”, begins at approximately 3.15 and declines to approximately 2.47, also showing a steep initial decline. A maroon line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)”, begins at approximately 3.1 and declines to approximately 2.48, similarly displaying a rapid initial decrease. Finally, a navy blue line, labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, begins at approximately 3.2 and declines to approximately 2.57, following the trend of an initial sharp decline before leveling off.
